correctness.rationale: Equal adjacent bits are immutable. Their fronts advance one site per time, yielding the exact iff flip occurs at t iff initial centered block length 2t+3 alternates; verified for all labelled states n=3..14. Even-parity XOR edge differences counted by signed (m-1)-state cyclic traces plus two globally alternating inputs; both matrix signs independently recomputed. In the logarithmic window, forbidden-start events are m-dependent hard-core; proper subsets of ring XOR differences are independent and fixed factorial moments converge to Poisson. Exact probability follows from U=0, all n>=3, t>=0.

value.rationale: The natural complete distribution of first periodic-entry times on every finite ring and the sharp logarithmic rare-pattern cutoff answer a dynamical relaxation question not resolved by knowing eventual cycles.
